## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh before merge: refreshing an edited tracked file currently makes verification accept the edit. This review read both changed files and traced both helpers against the added tests; tests were not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register previously unlisted files, with tests for registration and preservation behavior.

## Critical
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — When `tracked.txt` has been hand-edited and `names` contains `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]`, your refresh helper replaces its original digest, causing `verify` to return true. The assignment overwrites existing entries unconditionally; the refresh test supplies unchanged tracked content and therefore misses this failure. — Refreshing after adding a file can erase evidence of edits to tracked files, defeating the stated integrity guarantee.
